topics.title: 144-Hour Visa-Free Transit in China: Who Qualifies
China Tax Residency: The 183-Day Threshold
mustSay: The 183-day threshold is what separates a resident from a non-resident for tax purposes.
Days are counted within a calendar year, not across a rolling twelve months.
A resident is taxed on worldwide income; a non-resident on China-source income.
Treaty tie-breakers and the six-year rule can change the answer; a professional should confirm.
avoid: Do not state a tax rate, a deduction, or a bracket.
Do not describe the six-year rule in numbers unless the fact sheet contains them.

topics.title: China Residence Permit: Renewal and Overstay
mustSay: A residence permit has an expiry date and must be extended before it passes.
Overstaying is penalised per day, and the penalty has a ceiling.
The renewal is filed before expiry at the exit-entry authority that issued the permit.
Working on a permit that does not authorise work is a separate offence from overstaying.
avoid: Do not state a fee or a processing time unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Social Insurance for Foreign Employees in China
mustSay: Foreign employees working in China are covered by the social insurance scheme.
The scheme has several branches, and the employer pays a share of each.
Rates differ by city; a national figure does not exist.
Bilateral agreements can exempt some nationals from part of the contribution.
avoid: Do not state a contribution rate unless the fact sheet contains one for a named city.

topics.title: Converting a Foreign Driving Licence in China
mustSay: A foreign licence is converted, not exchanged automatically: there is an application and usually a test.
The applicant needs a valid residence status of a minimum duration.
The theory test is the common requirement; the road test depends on the issuing country.
The foreign licence must be valid and translated.
avoid: Do not state a fee or a test length unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Shipping Household Goods to China: Cost per m³
topics.query: shipping household goods to china cost
mustSay: Unaccompanied baggage is a customs category with its own declaration.
The price is quoted per cubic metre, and the volume is measured, not estimated by weight.
Door-to-door and port-to-door are different products with different prices.
This is a market estimate, not a published tariff.
avoid: Do not present a market estimate as an official rate.

topics.title: Z Visa or M Visa: Which China Visa You Need
topics.query: china z visa vs m visa
mustSay: The Z visa is for employment and is converted into a residence permit after arrival.
The M visa is for commercial and trade visits, not for working.
A work permit notification is required before a Z visa is issued.
The fee is set per nationality by reciprocity, so it is not one number.
avoid: Do not state a visa fee unless the fact sheet contains one for a named nationality.

topics.title: What It Costs to Employ a Foreigner in China
topics.query: cost to hire foreign employee china
mustSay: The monthly cost of an expatriate has three parts: salary, employer social insurance, and the amortised cost of the permit.
Employer contributions are a percentage of a declared salary base that is capped per city.
The permit and its renewals are a recurring cost, not a one-off.
This is an estimate and must be recalculated per city.
avoid: Do not state a salary figure: it is the employer's decision, not a published rate.

topics.title: Extending a China Visa Without Leaving
mustSay: A visa can be extended, changed or reissued inside China, but only at the exit-entry authority that has jurisdiction over where you are.
The application is made before the current stay expires; an overstay is a separate offence with its own penalty.
The reasons that justify an extension are a closed list, not any reason the applicant prefers.
A stay permit is a different document from a residence permit.
avoid: Do not state a fee or a processing time unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Registering Where You Stay as a Foreigner
mustSay: A foreigner staying somewhere other than a hotel is registered with the local public security bureau.
Hotels register their guests as part of check-in; a private address does not.
The registration is tied to an address and a period, and it is asked for at the residence-permit desk.
Failing to register is a fine, and the fine is stated in the regulation.
avoid: Do not state a number of hours or a fine unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: China Permanent Residence: What the Route Requires
topics.query: china permanent residence green card requirements
mustSay: Permanent residence is applied for under a specific category, and the categories have different evidence requirements.
The application is decided by the National Immigration Administration, not by the local police.
A permanent residence permit has a validity period and is renewed.
Meeting the category is necessary, not sufficient; the authority still decides.
avoid: Do not state an income threshold, an investment amount or a processing time unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: The Work Permit That Comes Before the Z Visa
mustSay: The work permit notification is issued before the visa, by the science and technology authority, not the visa office.
The visa and the permit are two documents held by two different authorities.
The permit is classified, and the classification determines what the employer must prove.
The permit becomes a residence permit after arrival.
avoid: Do not state a fee, a validity period or a processing time unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Getting Your China Entry and Exit Record
mustSay: The record is issued by the exit-entry authority and covers the dates you entered and left.
It is requested in person or through the official platform, and the applicant proves identity.
It is the document a bank, a school or a residence-permit desk asks for when it wants a stay history.
The record states facts; it does not state purpose of travel.
avoid: Do not state a fee or a processing time unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Reconciling Your China Income Tax as a Foreigner
topics.query: china individual income tax annual reconciliation foreigner
mustSay: An annual reconciliation is a filing, separate from the monthly withholding an employer does.
Whether a foreigner must file depends on the income, the withholding and the residence status that year.
The reconciliation window is set by the tax authority for a period each year, not chosen by the taxpayer.
Treaty relief is claimed in the filing, not automatically applied.
avoid: Do not state a threshold, a rate or a deduction unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Opening a Chinese Bank Account on a Foreign Passport
topics.query: opening bank account china foreigner documents
mustSay: The account is opened in person, and the bank verifies identity against the passport and the visa or permit.
A proof of address is usually asked for, and a residence registration is often what satisfies it.
The name on the account must match the passport exactly, including the order of the names.
Online banking and cross-border receipt differ between account classes; the branch decides the class.
avoid: Do not state a deposit minimum or a fee unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: A Chinese Phone Number: Real-Name Registration
topics.query: china sim card real name registration passport
mustSay: A phone line is registered to a verified identity before it is activated.
A foreigner registers with a passport, and the registration is what links the number to the person.
Banking, delivery and platform accounts increasingly require a number registered to the holder.
A number registered to somebody else cannot be used as proof of identity.
avoid: Do not state a fee or a validity period unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Permanent Residence Through Marriage
topics.query: china permanent residence through marriage requirements
mustSay: Marriage is one of the categories for permanent residence, and it has its own conditions.
The conditions concern the duration of the marriage and the time spent living in China.
The application is decided by the immigration authority, and meeting the conditions is necessary rather than sufficient.
The permit is renewed, so the status is not permanent in the sense of never expiring.
avoid: Do not state a number of years, an income or a fee unless the fact sheet contains it.

topics.title: Health Cover for Foreigners Working in China
mustSay: There are two different things: the statutory employee scheme and a commercial policy an employer buys.
The statutory scheme is tied to social insurance registration, and it varies by city.
A commercial policy is what covers treatment outside the scheme, and the two are not substitutes.
Which one applies depends on the employment status, not on nationality alone.
avoid: Do not state a premium or a reimbursement rate unless the fact sheet contains one for a named city.

topics.title: Renting in China: Contract, Deposit and Registration
topics.query: renting apartment china foreigner deposit contract
mustSay: A tenancy is a written contract, and the deposit is a term of that contract rather than a custom.
The landlord's right to let the flat is evidenced by a property certificate, which the tenant can ask to see.
A foreign tenant needs the address registered for the residence permit, and the landlord is part of that.
Disputes follow the contract and the deposit terms, so what is written matters more than what was said.
avoid: Do not state a typical deposit multiple or a rent level unless the fact sheet contains it.
